name: Capture Inbox
author: Carlos Granier
description: Save links, notes and screenshots as Markdown files with one key, and see what you captured, what is still waiting, and a box for a quick note.

barWidget.description: Shows captures waiting for the webhook to come back and sends them when it does; lists recent captures; takes a quick note.

schema.label: Capture command
schema.description: Empty uses the bundled capture CLI (Markdown files in a folder). Name another CLI with the same subcommands to use that instead.

schema.label: Journal file to watch
schema.description: Only needed with a custom command whose journal is somewhere else.

schema.label: Send waiting captures automatically
schema.description: While something is waiting, check once a minute whether the webhook answers, and send the queue when it does.
